jobs.title: Service Manager - Cortland Broomfield
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As the Service Manager, you are responsible for leading the maintenance team and ensuring the physical integrity, safety, and overall functionality of a multimillion‑dollar multifamily community. You oversee all maintenance operations, guide preventative programs, manage workflow and staffing, and ensure timely, high‑quality service that supports resident satisfaction and asset preservation. This role combines strong technical expertise with leadership, organization, and exceptional customer service. Maintenance Leadership & Technical Expertise Diagnose and resolve complex maintenance issues across electrical, plumbing, HVAC, appliance, structural, lighting, and security systems. Ensure the community operates efficiently by proactively identifying areas needing repair or improvement. Guide the team in anticipating and preventing resident issues through consistent upkeep and early problem detection. Serve as the primary point of contact for creating a safe, reliable, and worry‑free living environment. Team Management & Performance Oversight Support a team of maintenance technicians, ensuring timely, high‑quality completion of routine maintenance and repairs. Provide training, guidance, and mentorship, encouraging adherence to safety protocols and company standards. Assign and prioritize daily tasks, inspect completed work, and step into complete hands‑on repairs when necessary. Promote a strong safety culture with continuous attention to hazards, preventative act

jobs.title: Service Technician-East Ridge Park
jobs.description_text: Role Overview As a Service Technician, you help create a safe, well‑maintained, and comfortable living environment for residents. You are responsible for performing basic maintenance tasks, supporting unit turnovers, maintaining community spaces, and delivering prompt, friendly, and high‑quality service. Perform routine maintenance and basic repairs, including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, painting, and general apartment upkeep. Complete make‑ready tasks to ensure vacant units are clean, functional, and ready for new residents. Maintain overall property appearance, including daily ground upkeep and trash removal. Report safety hazards, recurring issues, or larger maintenance needs to your supervisor. Qualifications 1-2+ years of experience in maintenance, facilities, or related work preferred. Basic knowledge of household repairs and use of hand tools (or willingness to learn). Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently or within a team. Strong customer‑service skills and a professional attitude. Ability to lift, carry, climb ladders, and work in various indoor/outdoor conditions. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

With DiDi Voyager's real-world driving data and large-scale evaluation infrastructure, the goal is a loop that produces improvements that generalize across scenarios, pass safety gates, and reach the vehicle. jobs.location_raw: San Francisco, Bay Area OR Pittsburgh, PA
jobs.description_text: Efficient Computer is building the next generation of energy efficient, general-purpose processors designed around the Fabric architecture, a novel spatial dataflow design spun out from decades of fundamental SOC research at CMU. We are looking for a Senior Staff Linux Kernel Driver Engineer to own the kernel-mode driver that brings our Fabric to life.
